titel: Competition for architectural design for the reconstruction of the Christophe Ramon sports hall
kurzbeschreibung: Competition for the reconstruction of a sports hall on La Réunion that has become unusable due to cyclone damage.
umfang: Reconstruction of the Christophe Ramon sports hall to improve and diversify the municipal sports offering and to create suitable conditions for sports activities and competitions in line with the requirements of the sports federations; no information on GFA, spans, spectator capacity or structure.
leistungen: Competition for architectural design / maîtrise d’œuvre for the reconstruction of a sports hall; no specific specialist lots or service phases stated.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Sports hall is in principle a project type of interest for sbp in the field of sports / long-span structures.
• Early competition phase offers a strategic entry opportunity via architectural teams and structural concepts.
• Reconstruction after cyclone damage may entail increased requirements for robustness, sustainability and structural design.
• Location La Réunion is geographically interesting within the French market and close to the target region Africa/Indian Ocean.
• However, there is no specific information on spans, size, structure and budget, therefore no top rating.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated in the tender notice. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of information on GFA, hall dimensions, extent of stands, technical equipment and structure. For municipal sports halls of this type, a medium single- to double-digit million amount would be conceivable, but not reliable enough for a numerical indication.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee explicitly stated. As neither construction costs nor the scope of structural design nor competition remuneration are specified, no reliable fee estimate is possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Selection based on resources, joint experience of the members of the design team, technical and financial capacities, and suitability of references in relation to the complexity and financial significance of the project; particularly relevant recent references for cultural buildings or projects of comparable complexity; alignment of the team composition with the required competencies. In phase 2 exactly 6 applicants will be invited.
zuschlagskriterien: No percentage weighting stated. Evaluation based on: 1) human resources, joint experience, technical and financial capacities of the team; 2) suitability of capacities and references in relation to the project subject, financial significance and architectural quality of completed projects; 3) appropriateness of the team composition in relation to the required competencies.
auftraggeber: Commune de Saint-Benoît, 21 Rue Georges Pompidou, 97470 Saint-Benoît, France, e-mail: dacpaj@ville-saintbenoit.re, telephone: 0262508800, website: https://www.achatpublic.com/
notes: Restricted design competition. Trigger is the unusability of the existing hall since March 2025 after damage caused by cyclone Garance. Start of service provision expected on 20.12.2026, duration 24 months. Deadline for additional information: 07.08.2026, 12:00. Submission exclusively electronic and in French.
